text: Prof namin laging late tapos sa exam siya pa yung galit kapag may nagtatanong. Ano ba talaga, bakit kami ang may kasalanan lagi
Grabe yung registrar, 3 beses na ako pinabalik para sa isang form. Sayang pamasahe at oras, walang maayos na sistema.
Our professor reads slides word for word for 3 hours and then gives a quiz on things he never explained. What are we even paying for?
Hindi nagrereply ang dean's office sa email namin kahit dalawang linggo na. Ganito ba talaga kapag student concern lang?
Sino ba nag-approve ng schedule na 7am to 8pm may isang subject lang sa gitna? Walang puso ang sched maker, promise.
Our instructor publicly humiliated a classmate for a wrong answer. Zero professionalism. Report ka lang ng report pero walang aksyon.
Late na naman ang announcement ng class suspension. 9am na, nasa jeep na kami. Ang hirap umasa sa school na ito.
Yung grades ko hindi pa rin nailalabas at tapos na ang sem. Wala man lang update from the department. Nakakastress.
Mandatory na naman ang bayad para sa event na hindi naman namin hiniling. Student funds ba talaga ang pinaglalaruan nyo?
SDO keeps enforcing rules about hair and uniform but ignores real problems. Priorities po??
Grabe magturo si sir, parang wala siyang paki kung may natututunan kami. Puro 'basahin nyo na lang sa module.'
The student council posts a lot but never answers when we actually ask for help. Parang pang-display lang.
Nagbago na naman ang syllabus sa kalagitnaan ng sem tapos kami pa ang pinapahirapan. Sino ba nagplano nito?
Professor gave us 5 activities due in one night and then marked us late for submitting at 11:59. Unfair talaga.
Ang tagal mag process ng scholarship papers sa office. Tatlong buwan na, wala pa ring sagot kung approved ba o hindi.
Teacher keeps changing the grading criteria without telling us. Nobody knows how we are graded, super unclear.
Pinagalitan kami ng prof dahil nagtanong kami ng clarification. Tapos sasabihin 'ask me anything' hahaha ok.
Required pa rin ang onsite exam kahit hindi nakapasok ang karamihan dahil sa baha. Sana naman may consideration po.
Walang consistent policy sa attendance, depende sa prof. Yung isa pwede late, yung isa absent agad. Magulo.
The department head dismissed our complaint as 'just feedback'. Then asks why students don't trust the system.
Sobrang tagal ng response ng guidance office, tapos pag nakapag-usap na, generic lang ang sagot. Disappointed.
Nag-email ako sa admin 4 times for my TOR request. Nothing. Walang sense yung online system nila.
Instructor cancelled class without notice again, pero nag-deduct ng attendance sa amin? Sino pa po ang may kasalanan dito 😒
Uso na naman ang 'pakitingnan na lang sa advisory' pero wala namang advisory sa page. Communication fail ulit.
Yung proctor namin sa exam sumigaw sa harap ng buong klase dahil lang sa pagbagsak ng lapis ko. Hiyang-hiya ako.
Everything is online but the school still asks us to submit printed copies. Ang sarap magreklamo pero wala ring nakikinig.
Hindi patas ang pagbibigay ng grades dito, depende sa kung sino ang paborito ng prof. Favoritism talaga.
Ang daming bayarin sa enrollment na hindi maipaliwanag ng cashier. Everyone just shrugs and says 'ganyan talaga'.
Yung org clearance process nila ay parang maze. Apat na signature, apat na magkakaibang opisina, lahat sarado pag lunch.
Professor told us 'study on your own' then gave a quiz about topics never taught. Gusto ko na lang mag-drop.
Ma'am explains things step by step and always repeats when we get lost. Grabe ang patience, thank you po!
Sir always replies to our messages kahit gabi na. Ganito dapat ang professor, approachable at fair.
Napakabilis ng registrar ngayong sem, 10 minutes lang tapos na ang request ko. Salamat po sa staff!
The dean listened to our concerns and actually fixed the schedule conflict within a week. Appreciate it a lot.
My professor gave us the grading rubric on day one and followed it. Fair, clear, and very organized.
Ang bait ng guidance counselor namin, tinulungan niya ako sa problema ko sa sched. Salamat po talaga.
Thank you to our instructor for extending the deadline when half the class had no internet. Very considerate.
Sobrang galing magturo ni sir, kahit mahirap ang subject, naintindihan ko dahil sa mga halimbawa niya.
The scholarship office processed my papers in two days and even reminded me of the next requirement. Great service!
Early announcement ng suspension ngayon, 5am pa lang meron na. Thank you admin, nakatipid kami sa pamasahe.
Our adviser stayed after class to help us revise our thesis outline. Words can't say how grateful we are.
Prof ko binigyan kami ng review session kahit hindi required. Ang laking tulong sa exam.
The student council actually followed up on our request for extra printers. Finally some action, thank you!
Mabilis sumagot ang SDO sa email at malinaw ang sagot nila. Ang saya na maayos ang proseso.
Prof was strict but fair, and I learned more in his class than in any other this year. Highly recommended.
Ma'am always asks how we are doing before starting the lesson. Rare to find a teacher who cares like that.
Salamat sa dean namin, nakinig siya sa feedback ng mga estudyante at binago ang schedule para hindi kami mahirapan.
I appreciate that our professors post modules early so we can plan ahead. Super helpful for working students.
Nagpa-consultation si sir tungkol sa grades bago ilabas ang final. Transparent at professional.
Best instructor I've had so far, makes even boring topics fun. Sana lahat ng prof ganito.
Reminder: online classes po tayo bukas dahil sa bagyo. Check your class channels for updates from your professors.
Ask lang po, kailangan pa ba ng clearance bago mag-enroll sa next sem? Wala pa ako nakikitang announcement.
Advisory: Midterm exams are moved to next week. Please refer to your department postings for the new schedule.
May alam ba kayo kung kailan open ang scholarship application? Hindi ko makita sa website.
Office hours of the registrar this week are 9am to 4pm only. Bring a valid ID when requesting documents.
Tanong lang, required pa ba ang uniform sa online days? Walang malinaw na sagot ang prof namin.
Notice to all students: the deadline for dropping subjects is on Friday. Visit your college office for the form.
Sino po ang pwedeng lapitan para sa grade appeal? Dean ba o department head?
Reminder from the SDO: Org activity permits must be filed at least one week before the event.
Kailan po ang release ng grades for finals? May nakaka-alam ba?
Ang init sa room namin, walang aircon tapos 40 kami sa loob. Paano kami makakapag-focus sa exam?
Walang sabon sa CR ng second floor ng ilang linggo na. Basic hygiene lang po.
The wifi disconnects every five minutes during online quizzes. Tapos kami ang sinisisi pag di nakapasa ng on time.
Sobrang mahal ng rice meal sa canteen pero kakarampot ang ulam. Php 90 para sa isang pirasong chicken at kanin lang?
Laging sira ang elevator sa gusali namin, kailangan pang umakyat ng hagdan ng anim na palapag habang may bitbit na mabigat na gamit.
Ang daming surot sa upuan sa library, nangangati ako buong gabi pagkatapos mag-aral doon.
Parking is a nightmare, we circle for 40 minutes and still no slot. Guards just wave us off.
Yung water fountain may lumot at amoy kalawang. Delikado talagang uminom diyan.
The canteen food gave half my friends stomach aches last week. Hygiene is clearly not a priority.
Sira ang projector sa room 304 pero ilang linggo na wala pa ring ayos. Nagsusulat na lang kami sa board.
Walang saksakan sa library, tapos bawal pa mag-charge sa labas ng room. Ano gagawin namin, magpatay ng phone?
Ang baho ng CR sa ground floor, hindi na yata nililinis. Sobrang nakakadiri.
Ang ingay ng construction sa tabi ng library kaya imposible mag-aral. Tapos sasabihin nila quiet zone.
The bookstore is always out of stock of the required books, then sells them at triple price outside. Ganda ng system.
Overpriced na nga ang pagkain, madalas pa kulang sa sukli ang cashier ng canteen. Nakakapagod.
Mainit sa gym tapos walang electric fan. PE class namin, muntik na may himatayin kahapon.
The security guards check bags aggressively and rudely. Wala namang respeto sa estudyante.
Walang upuan sa hallway at bawal umupo sa sahig. Saan kami tatambay between classes?
Lagi na lang puno ang lockers at sira pa yung iba. Ninakawan na ang isang kaklase namin.
The aircon is set to freezing cold in the lab but the lecture rooms are like saunas. Make it make sense lol.
Naka-block yung hagdan tuwing may event, hindi kami makadaan papunta sa room. Delikado na rin.
Madilim ang hallway sa gabi at walang ilaw sa parking. Hindi safe para sa mga night class.
Hindi na talaga gumagana yung mga printer sa library, pila pa rin kami sa labas para magpa-print.
Yung mga upuan sa lecture hall, sira at maliit. Hindi komportable umupo ng tatlong oras.
The cafeteria runs out of food by 11am, then we are left with nothing. Not even bread.
Ang bagal ng elevator tuwing rush hour, minsan 20 minutes ang pila. Late tuloy kami sa klase.
Walang malinis na ladies' room sa building namin, laging may tubig sa sahig at walang tissue. Kadiri.
Sirang-sira ang mga electric fan sa room namin, parang hangin lang ng aso ang lumalabas.
Library staff keep shushing us but they themselves talk loudly at the counter. Double standard much 🙄
Pagod na kaming magreklamo sa leak sa ceiling. Every time it rains, nababasa ang notes namin.
The new study lounge is so comfy and quiet, finally a place to review between classes. Thank you!
Ang sarap ng bagong menu sa canteen, malinis at mura pa. Sana tuloy-tuloy na ito.
Library has free laptop loans and the staff is really helpful. I got my research done way faster.
Napakalinis ng CR sa bagong building, may sabon at tissue pa. Appreciate the maintenance team.
The aircon in our room is perfect now. Thank you for fixing it so quickly, super productive na ulit.
Mabilis na ang wifi sa campus ngayon, kahit video call ay hindi na nagla-lag. Sobrang laking tulong.
Love the new charging stations in the hallway, hindi na ako nauubusan ng battery.
Ang ganda ng garden sa may quadrangle, ang sarap tumambay habang naghihintay ng next class.
The science lab is well equipped and every student gets to use the apparatus. Great facility.
Napakabait ng mga guard ngayon, sila pa ang nag-guide sa amin papunta sa tamang building.
The canteen now accepts GCash and the queue is so much shorter. Thank you for listening to us!
Malinis at maayos ang gym namin, may electric fans na at bagong sahig. Ang saya mag-PE ngayon.
Ang bagong elevator ay mabilis at hindi na nasisira. Ang laking ginhawa lalo na sa mga night class.
Library hours were extended during exam week. Such a huge help for students who commute far.
The cafeteria food is actually good and affordable. Student-friendly prices at malaki pa ang serving.
Mas maliwanag na ngayon ang hallway sa gabi, mas safe na kami sa night class. Thank you po.
Nakakatuwa na may bagong lockers kaming magagamit, maayos at may susi pa. Salamat sa admin.
Clean restrooms, working aircon and fast wifi. I honestly can't complain about the facilities this year.
Mabilis ang printing sa library at mura lang. Hindi na kami nahihirapan magpa-print ng requirements.
The campus feels so safe with the new CCTV and friendly guards. Parents will love it too.
Saan po yung bagong printing area? Hindi ko makita sa building namin.
Open ang library hanggang 7pm ngayong week, Monday to Saturday.
Anong oras bukas ang canteen tuwing Sabado? Balak ko mag-lunch doon bago ang makeup class.
Reminder: the elevator in Building G is under maintenance until Friday. Please use the stairs.
May nakakaalam ba kung may tubig na sa water fountain sa 3rd floor? Wala ako dalang tumbler.
The computer lab will be closed for cleaning on Thursday morning. Classes will use Room 210 instead.
May bayad ba ang locker rental o libre lang sa lahat ng students?
Pwede ba mag-charge ng laptop sa library? May outlet ba sa mga table?
Where can I find a quiet place to study near the campus? Library is full every afternoon.
Saan po pwedeng magpa-photocopy sa loob ng school? Kailangan ko lang ng ilang pages.
Honestly one of the best decisions I made was enrolling here. The community is friendly and the teachers really care.
Mahal ko ang school na ito, andami kong natutunan at ang bait ng mga kaibigan ko dito. Worth it.
As a faculty member here, I enjoy teaching bright students and the support from the department is real. Happy to be part of this school.
Maganda ang environment, magaling ang mga prof at hindi sobrang toxic ng culture. I recommend it to anyone.
Four years in and I have zero regrets. I grew a lot academically and personally.
The tuition is reasonable compared to other private schools and the installment plan helps a lot.
Sobrang saya ng buhay estudyante dito, laging may events at active ang mga orgs. Hindi ka mabo-bore.
I transferred here last year and it was the best move. Mas maayos ang sistema at mas approachable ang mga prof.
Magandang school kung gusto mo ng strong foundation sa course mo. Nagpapasalamat ako sa lahat ng natutunan ko.
Yung mga professors dito, may real-world experience at nakakapagbahagi talaga ng practical knowledge. Sobrang valuable.
As an alumna, I can say the school prepared me well for my board exam and my first job. Thank you, alma mater!
Safe ang campus, mababait ang mga tao, at maganda ang facilities. Solid choice for incoming freshmen.
Don't believe everyone who says this school is bad. My experience has been great so far, especially with the faculty.
I love how close-knit the student community is. Everyone helps each other during exams and projects.
Okay talaga dito kung naghahanap ka ng balanced na college life. May academics, may fun, may support.
Working here as an instructor has been rewarding. Colleagues are collaborative and students are respectful.
Grabe ang naging pagbabago ko sa school na ito, from shy freshman to student leader. Thank you po sa lahat ng nag-guide sa akin.
Good school overall with good values. I would send my younger sibling here without hesitation.
Nakakuha ako ng scholarship at nasuportahan ako ng school hanggang makatapos. Forever grateful.
Maganda ang training namin sa internship program ng school, may partner companies talaga at maraming opportunity.
Para sa akin, worth it ang tuition dahil sa quality ng teaching at facilities. Hindi nasayang ang binayad namin.
Super friendly ng mga upperclassmen at professors, hindi ka mawawala dito kahit freshman ka pa lang.
The campus culture is warm and welcoming. I felt at home from my very first day.
Highly recommend this school for working students, flexible ang schedule at supportive ang mga prof.
Dito ko nahanap ang passion ko at mga lifelong friends. Pinakamagandang chapter ng buhay ko.
I enjoy my classes, the professors are knowledgeable, and the library is a great place to study. Solid experience.
Maganda ang reputation ng school sa industry, madaling makahanap ng trabaho pagka-graduate.
Honest review: better than I expected. Strict in academics pero fair, and you really learn.
Maraming opportunities dito para sa mga student leaders. Ang dami kong natutunan sa mga orgs at events.
The best part of studying here is the people. Every professor I met wanted us to succeed.
Do not enroll here unless you enjoy being ignored. Every office passes you around like a hot potato.
Sayang ang tuition. Ang dami nilang pinapabayad pero ang daming sira sa campus at walang pakialam ang admin.
This school is trash when it comes to student support. Nobody replies, nobody cares, nobody fixes anything 🙄
Sobrang toxic ng environment dito, puro tsismis at paborito. Hindi ko inirerekomenda sa kahit sino.
Wala akong natutunan sa dalawang taon ko dito. Puro requirements, walang tunay na turo.
Absolutely ridiculous how this place treats students. Pay first, complain later, and still get ignored 🤡
Napakabagal ng sistema at puro delay. Ang laki ng tuition pero parang public school sa serbisyo.
I regret enrolling here. The promises on the brochure and the actual experience are two different worlds.
Pinapahirapan lang kami ng school na ito. Puro rules, walang kwenta ang support.
Honestly the worst semester of my life. Disorganized, unfair, and nobody takes responsibility.
Ang daming pa-feeling sa school na ito, pero pagdating sa tulong sa students, nganga. Nakakadismaya.
Wow, another memo at 11pm that cancels everything we planned. Amazing management 👏👏 truly world class.
Pag may reklamo ka, ikaw pa ang lalabas na masama. Hindi healthy ang culture dito.
This school only cares about enrollment numbers, not student well-being. Very obvious.
Kung may choice ka lang, wag dito. Marami namang ibang school na mas maayos.
Mahina ang quality ng education dito, outdated ang lessons at walang practical training.
Ginagawa nilang negosyo ang edukasyon. Lahat may bayad, lahat may extra charge.
I feel like just a number here. Nobody knows my name and nobody listens to my problems.
Ang hirap mag-enjoy dito kapag lagi kang stressed sa ka-disorganize ng lahat. Pagod na ako.
Pathetic how they treat scholars. One bad grade and you're out, with zero support or guidance.
Nakakapagod ang school na ito. Walang respeto sa oras at pera ng mga estudyante.
Overrated school, honestly. Mataas ang tuition pero mababa ang quality. Disappointed.
Everyone says this is a good school but my experience was a nightmare. Bad advisers, bad schedules, bad everything.
Walang maayos na communication ang school. Lahat ng info, nalalaman namin sa group chat at hindi sa admin.
Nagsisisi ako na dito ako nag-enroll. Kung alam ko lang na ganito, nag-transfer na sana ako agad.
The school markets itself as student-centered but never acts like it. Total clowns 🤡
Ang gulo ng lahat dito, magulo ang schedule, magulo ang rules, magulo ang management. Grabe.
As a faculty member I can say the management here is unsupportive and chaotic. Many of us are thinking of leaving.
Magaling lang sa marketing ang school na ito, pero sa totoong serbisyo, bagsak.
Avoid this place if you value your sanity. Burnout is guaranteed and support is non-existent.
Hello po, okay po ba yung BS Accountancy sa school na ito? Balak ko po sanang mag-enroll next year.
Any thoughts on the nursing program here? I'm still deciding between two schools.
Magkano po ang tuition ng Education course? Hindi ko makita ang exact amount sa website.
How is the campus life for freshmen? Looking for honest pros and cons.
May scholarship ba para sa mga athletes? Balak ko mag-apply sa varsity.
Gaano kalayo ang school sa MRT? Kailangan ko malaman kasi commuter ako.
Is it hard to get into the engineering program? What are the requirements?
Pwede ba ang transferee mid-year? Anong documents ang kailangan?
Do you recommend this school for senior high? Looking for feedback from parents and students.
Anong course ang pinakamaganda dito? Undecided pa ako sa pagitan ng IT at Business.
Any dorms or boarding houses near the school? Taga-province kasi ako.
May mga night classes ba sa school? Working student kasi ako.
Is the school accredited? I want to make sure before I enroll my younger brother.
How strict are the professors here? Asking as incoming freshman.
Ano ang ine-expect sa first year? First time ko mag-college kaya medyo kinakabahan.
Magkano ang average na monthly expenses ng student dito, kasama pamasahe at pagkain?
Are there good student organizations here? I want to join something related to design.
May available pa bang slot sa second semester? Hindi ko alam kung sino ang kokontakin.
Does the school offer online or blended classes? Hindi ko kaya mag-commute araw-araw.
What is the vibe of the students here, friendly ba or competitive? Just curious.

Selling my used Calculus textbook, Php 400 lang. Pm me if interested, pwede meet-up sa school.
Lost and found: black umbrella left in Room 202. Message me if it's yours.
Looking for a roommate near campus, Php 3,500 per month, shared kitchen and wifi. Message me.
Anyone selling a second-hand drawing tablet? Budget is around Php 3,000.
Hello po, may nakaiwan ng ID sa jeep kanina sa may Shaw. Pakicheck po kung sa inyo.
Recommend a good laundromat near the dorm area? Thank you in advance.
WTS: Nursing uniform size small, used only twice, Php 800. Willing to meet around the school gate.
Anyone want to join a study group for Statistics? We meet on Sundays at the coffee shop nearby.
Looking for tutors in Chemistry, preferably online. Paid po. Message me your rates.
May nakakaalam ba ng magandang print shop malapit sa school? Mura pero maayos.
Free to a good home: two kittens, vaccinated. Pwede ma-pick up sa Mandaluyong.
Planning a weekend trip to Tagaytay, who's in? Share costs for the van rental.
Someone stole my wallet at the jeepney stop near the gate. Ingat po kayo sa mga kasabay nyo, ang daming manloloko.
Ang daming scammer sa FB marketplace, nawalan ako ng Php 2,000 sa fake seller. Beware!
Nakakainis yung jeepney driver na nanlaban pa nang magtanong ako ng sukli. Ang baba ng respeto sa pasahero.
Can someone explain why the street outside always floods after five minutes of rain? Nakakapagod lumusong araw-araw.
Sobrang traffic sa EDSA ngayon, 3 hours akong na-stuck. Hindi na talaga okay ang commute dito.
I'm so tired of group chats with 200 unread messages. Mute na lang, wala ng saysay.
Ang mahal na ng bilihin sa palengke, wala na tuloy kaming maipon sa allowance. Hirap ng buhay estudyante.
Ang ingay ng neighbors namin hanggang 2am, hindi ako makatulog bago mag-exam. Nakakainis.
Found a lovely little cafe near campus with cheap iced coffee and strong wifi. Highly recommended for study dates!
Thank you to the kind stranger who returned my phone at the jeepney terminal. Faith in humanity restored 💙
Ang sarap ng bagong ramen place sa Shaw, mura at malaki ang serving. Babalik talaga kami.
Beautiful sunset today on the walk home. Little things like this make tiring days worth it.
Salamat sa tindera sa harap ng school, laging may libreng sauce at nakangiti pa. Ang bait!
